method.difference: target JPEG minus 0300; ΔE76 is nonnegative Euclidean distance in Lab
method.color: Pillow decoded 8-bit RGB treated as sRGB; OpenCV float32 RGB2Lab D65/2deg; C=sqrt(a²+b²), hue=atan2(b,a) degrees
method.sampling: original coordinates x=4k+offset,y=4j+offset, no warp/interpolation; offsets 0 primary and 2 spatial control; neither is independent capture
method.masks: all masks defined once from 0300 on each grid; L bins [0,20,40,60,80,100.01]; hue 30deg bins with C>=10; boxes x0,y0,x1,y1 normalized, upper bound exclusive
method.registration: phase correlation grayscale on sampled grid, plus separate 3x3 tiles; translation only, brightness changes can affect estimate; no warp
method.jpeg: Pillow tables and subsampling identify encoding parameters, not measured compression error; no uncompressed reference
